Class KeyStore

java.lang.Object
io.github.jabrena.juno.jdk.security.KeyStore
public final class KeyStore extends Object
The board-side java.security.KeyStore: an in-memory store of trusted certificates for a java.net.http client's SSLContext. Start it empty with load(null, null) and add each certificate with setCertificateEntry(String, Certificate). A key store file cannot be read, and the store holds no private keys, so client certificates are not supported. The certificates are kept as one PEM chain; the aliases only count.
